g.text: GDHUB-89 — promotion codes, from the admin to the curator's payout

text.tspan: code, discount, times_redeemed / max, expires_at, first purchase, active
(nothing stored on our side: Stripe is the record)
code A–Z0–9, percent 1–99 OR amount USD, expires?, max uses?, first purchase?
(a free checkpoint is given by an admin, GDHUB-40)
AuditLog: promo code turned on / off
(Stripe never deletes a code; back on fails → 409 when it expired)
line item = full price (curator level × team size)
Stripe checks the code, its limits and expiry
the card is authorised for the discounted sum
Pro: hold until the curator answers
Refund after capture = what was captured
Curator's payout (by hand) is from Payment.amount
